about: A region condition on S3 (global) only avoids scanning the same buckets from every region: ignored, so no bullet says the rule is about us-east-1 (ENG-9302).

controls.output: - S3 buckets without default encryption are flagged. Buckets with default encryption pass. HIGH, ORG; reports only. acme:s3-encryption@1
- S3 buckets in any region without default encryption are flagged. Buckets with default encryption pass. HIGH, ORG; reports only. acme:s3-encryption@1
- S3 buckets in us-east-1 without default encryption are flagged. Other buckets pass. HIGH, ORG; reports only. acme:s3-encryption@1

- S3 buckets without default encryption are flagged, in every region (the policy's `us-east-1` condition only keeps the same buckets from being scanned twice). Buckets with default encryption pass. HIGH, ORG; reports only. acme:s3-encryption@1
- S3 buckets without default encryption are flagged, but only those the us-east-1 scan sees. Buckets with default encryption pass. HIGH, ORG; reports only. acme:s3-encryption@1
- S3 buckets without default encryption are flagged, but only in one region. Buckets with default encryption pass. HIGH, ORG; reports only. acme:s3-encryption@1
- S3 buckets (us-east-1 region) without default encryption are flagged. Buckets with default encryption pass. HIGH, ORG; reports only. acme:s3-encryption@1
- S3 buckets created in the us-east-1 region without default encryption are flagged. Buckets with default encryption pass. HIGH, ORG; reports only. acme:s3-encryption@1
